pre_source_arithmetic_expectations.safe_deferred3_3slots: Recorded0,1,2 read their own CB/SRV slots if allocations and descriptor contents remain intact.
pre_source_arithmetic_expectations.deferred4_3slots: Final CPU writes alias original slots: logical dispatch0 observes CB/SRV value3, then1,2,3. This assumes actual deferred-memory binding semantics, to be checked from root signature/source and GPU result.
pre_source_arithmetic_expectations.deferred5_3slots: Logical dispatches observe values3,4,2,3,4 for both aliased CB and SRV indices.
pre_source_arithmetic_expectations.enoughslots4or5: At least one nonreused CB and descriptor slot per recorded dispatch should preserve all original rows.
pre_source_arithmetic_expectations.fence_before_reuse: Previously submitted users must complete before CPU rewrites their slots; wait must precede rewrite, not merely precede final readback. Command allocator/list resets also need their previous GPU completion.
pre_source_arithmetic_expectations.split_CB3_descriptor5: Only CB value sequence aliases3,4,2,3,4; SRV values0..4 remain original.
pre_source_arithmetic_expectations.split_CB5_descriptor3: Only SRV sequence aliases3,4,2,3,4; CB values0..4 remain original.

required_binding_boundary: ComputeState records GPU VA for a root CBV and GPU descriptor-table handles. It does not explicitly copy CB contents into root constants. The reviewer will check the actual test shader's serialized root signature version/flags before claiming how mutable heap data is consumed.

Descriptor-table root parameters encode handle values, not automatically an independent descriptor snapshot in the source. Root-signature static/volatile declarations and command submission/lifetime contract qualify the experiment.
Per-dispatch CB/SRV arithmetic must encode independent CB/SRV IDs without overflow/float precision ambiguity, so one-slot factor controls identify which binding changed.
required_output_copy_boundary: One shared stable output UAV avoids different output descriptors accidentally selecting a later target. Each dispatch needs its own immediately subsequent GPU CopyTextureRegion to a distinct readback allocation; copying only after all dispatches merely measures final UAV overwrite.

Explicit UAV/CopySource state transitions must order each dispatch write before its copy and restore UAV for the next dispatch. Readback Map occurs only after the copy's fence completion; copy footprints/row pitches and resource lifetimes must be retained.
Input SRV resources must be initialized and held unchanged/alive across execution. Creating SRVs may overwrite heap entries, but must not mutate those resources themselves.
helper_adaptation_checks_pending: Exact ComputeState and FrameDescriptorHeap/helper extraction hash/token/byte comparisons against original source; only named standalone compile shims allowed.

Adapted split class must allocate enough CB/descriptor slots before initialization, then change independent modulo indices only. FrameDescriptorHeap owns raw COM pointers with a destructor and no explicit safe move/copy, so resizing an already initialized vector can create fixture-only ownership faults.
Initialize/destructor scope must keep upload buffers, shader-visible heaps, input/output/readback resources alive through execution fence.
scope: This is a pending source/protocol review, not evidence of an actual-game trigger, existing same-input native-variance cause, or stain/wave solution. External caller queue/frame-limit guarantees remain a separate investigation.
